title: Add camera constants and SBT local root bindings
motivation: We need camera control for raygen and a path to add local root parameters for future materials. This enables basic interactivity and correct ray generation.
deliverables: Keyboard/mouse input to move camera (WASD + mouse look)
Root signature update: add CBV(b0) for camera; keep SRV/UAV bindings
SBT records include local root data where needed or use global CBV binding
acceptance: Moving the camera changes the output
SBT builds with non-zero record sizes and correct strides
No debug layer errors during frame or on resize
implementation: Add Camera struct and update-per-frame buffer with upload heap
Update raygen shader to compute rays from inverse view-projection
Add minimal input handling in WndProc for now
notes: We can keep a global CBV for v1; local roots come later for materials
Align CB size to 256 bytes as required by D3D12
test_plan: Move camera and verify scene changes (even if only a gradient for now)
PIX capture to verify CBV binding and SBT record sizes
Stress resize; ensure CB recreation is handled
